title: Added dynamic-array formulas, error cells, and defined names to the XLSX export and import. With the Formulas plugin on, the XLSX export now writes each value with the type HyperFormula computed, even without `exportFormulas`: a computed number or `TRUE`/`FALSE` is no longer written as text, and an error is written as an Excel error instead of text. A formula written with a decimal comma (`decimalSeparator: ','`) is now exported with a dot, so Excel reads `1,5` as 1.5. The import keeps an array formula's spilled cells empty so it spills without `#SPILL!`, keeps the file's cached values where HyperFormula spills less, and registers the workbook's defined names in HyperFormula.
